evals.name: auth-header
evals.prompt: Every endpoint of our API (base `ApiEndpoint extends RestEndpoint` in src/resources/ApiEndpoint.ts) must send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` using `await getToken()` from src/lib/auth.ts. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Overrides getHeaders (or getRequestInit) on the base endpoint; does not override fetch.
assertions: Adds the header by overriding `getHeaders` or `getRequestInit`.

evals.name: shared-polling
evals.prompt: The dashboard shows `useLive(getTicker, { product_id })` with `pollFrequency: 5000`. The detail page needs the same product every 500ms. Add `getTickerFast = getTicker.extend({ pollFrequency: 500 })` for it; the dashboard should keep polling every 5s.
evals.expected_output: Explains that subscribers to the same args share one poll at the fastest frequency, so the dashboard would also poll at 500ms while the detail page is mounted.
assertions: States that both views share one poll at the fastest frequency, so the dashboard speeds up too.
Does not claim the extended endpoint polls independently.

evals.name: envelope-pagination
evals.source: Migration of alan2207/bulletproof-react@9506629 (apps/react-vite), problem record in https://github.com/reactive/data-client/pull/4607 (.agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/problems.md) P7
evals.prompt: Our API returns `GET /comments?discussionId=:id&page=:n` as `{ data: Comment[], meta: { page, total, totalPages } }` and `POST /comments?discussionId=:id` returns the created Comment. Using an `ApiEndpoint extends RestEndpoint` base class and a `Comment` Entity, define the endpoints so a comments list can show page 1, a 'Load more' button appends the next page, and creating a comment adds it to the same list. Show the component code for the list.
evals.expected_output: Envelope schema `{ data: new Collection([Comment]), meta: {...} }` with `paginationField: 'page'`; first fetch without `page`; load more with `getComments.getPage` and `page: meta.page + 1`; create with `getComments.push` (or a create endpoint whose schema is the same Collection's `.push` with args `{ discussionId }`). Library check: 'getPage and push should share one list inside a { data, meta } envelope' in packages/react/src/__tests__/integration-collections.tsx.
assertions: The list endpoint's schema keeps the envelope, with a `Collection` of `Comment` at `data` and `meta` alongside.
Sets `paginationField: 'page'` and loads more with `.getPage`, passing the next page from `meta`.
The first-page `useSuspense` call does not pass `page`.
Creating a comment uses `getComments.push` or a `.push` of the same Collection instance, with `{ discussionId }` args.
Does not unwrap `data` in `process()`, and does not refetch or `expireAll` the list after creating.
